positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked as a full-stack developer on core functionality and features for 'Anna', our AI powered data analyst. Used React, TypeScript / JavaScript, Kotlin, Scala, MySQL / MariaDB, PostgresDB.

positions.title: Graduate
positions.description:
Delivering new features on our web platforms for Colonial First State, NetBank, and CommBank website.

• Full-stack role, developing high quality, maintainable, unit tested C# and JavaScript code. Perform code reviews. 
• Up-to-date web development using the latest frameworks including React and Angular 4.
• SQL Server / Oracle Database design and development.
• Follow existing engineering best practices and push for new standards.
• Perform technical analysis and design for scalable RESTful backend solutions.
• Conduct analysis and fixes for production defects.
• Deployment and continuous integration/delivery of microservices onto AWS.
• Participation in internal ideation sessions with business stakeholders.
• Working in a fast paced agile environment with technical and non technical team members.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: A 10 week summer internship in the Enterprise Services division of the Commonwealth Bank. Over the timeframe, I learned about and developed multiple continuous delivery and productivity solutions using virtual machines and utilized various automation tools as a part of everyday work.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Major in Software Technology, Information Technology
